matched_projects.one_liner: In a course project I fit Bayesian stochastic block models to the FlyWire connectome to infer latent neuron types.

At Arborphy AI (advised by Prof. Tian Zheng, Columbia Statistics) I built and stress-tested a BioCLIP + EfficientNet fusion model for fine-grained plant species recognition, and found with a leakage-aware, multi-seed protocol that the fusion gains did not reliably beat a BioCLIP-only baseline.
